# Apoptosis and cell cycle (clean)

Gene expression profiling in the apoptosis and cell cycle pathway revealed significant perturbations. BCL2 was downregulated in the treated cells (Table 3). BAX was upregulated relative to the control arm (Table 3). CASP3 was elevated (Table 3).

TP53 was upregulated in this context (Table 3). CDKN1A was upregulated, consistent with p53-mediated cell cycle arrest (Table 3). MDM2 was modestly upregulated (Table 3). MYC was downregulated (Table 3).

CCND1 was downregulated consistent with reduced G1 progression (Table 3). EGFR was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 3). KRAS was modestly upregulated (Table 3).
